fields.Name: T118 - AI Agents Category Tree View Toggle
fields.Description: Exercises the mj-view-toggle + the mj-tree branch (CategoryBranchConfig/AgentLeafConfig) in agent-configuration, a distinct rendering path from the default agent card grid and unrelated to the generic entity grid.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the AI application using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box), then open the Agents section. In the toolbar there is a view toggle with Grid / List / Tree options - click the Tree (Category Tree View, folder-tree icon) option. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment - wait, don't navigate away. Success is seeing the agents re-render as a hierarchical category tree (agents grouped under expandable category branches) instead of the card grid - you do NOT need to click into any agent. A valid 'No agents found' empty tree also counts.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Grid/List/Tree view toggle is visible and clicking Tree changes the displayed layout from cards to a hierarchical tree (or a tree empty-state)
The tree shows expandable category branches with agents as leaf nodes, OR a clearly labelled empty tree state
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
